description: This file contains FastAPI endpoint definitions for managing customer-related operations in the application. It includes endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, blocking/unblocking users, listing all users, and getting customer activity data. The endpoints facilitate interactions with the database through an ORM (Prisma) and include detailed documentation and data validation logic.

classes.name: LiteLLM_EndUserTable
classes.description: Pydantic model representing the end user/customer table in the database.

classes.name: LiteLLM_BudgetTable
classes.description: Pydantic model representing the budget table for customers.

classes.name: UserAPIKeyAuth
classes.description: Authentication class handling API key-based user authentication and roles.

methods.name: block_user(data: BlockUsers)
methods.description: Blocks specified users by setting their 'blocked' status in the database.

methods.name: unblock_user(data: BlockUsers)
methods.description: Unblocks specified users by removing them from the blocked user list.

methods.name: new_end_user( data: NewCustomerRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Creates a new customer end-user entry in the database, optionally with a new budget.

methods.name: end_user_info( end_user_id: str = fastapi.Query( description="End User ID in the request parameters" ), )
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific end-user based on user ID.

methods.name: update_end_user( data: UpdateCustomerRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Updates details of an existing end-user, including associated budget information.

methods.name: delete_end_user( data: DeleteCustomerRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Deletes one or more end-users identified by user IDs.

methods.name: list_end_user( http_request: Request, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Lists all end-users accessible by the requesting user, with inclusion based on user roles.

methods.name: get_customer_daily_activity( end_user_ids: Optional[str] = None, start_date: Optional[str] = None, end_date: Optional[str] = None, model: Optional[str] = None, api_key: Optional[str] = None, page: int = 1, page_size: int = 10, exclude_end_user_ids: Optional[str] = None, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Fetches daily activity metrics for specified customers or all accessible customers.

ctags.name: end_user_info
ctags.signature: ( end_user_id: str = fastapi.Query( description="End User ID in the request parameters" ), )

ctags.name: get_customer_daily_activity
ctags.signature: ( end_user_ids: Optional[str] = None, start_date: Optional[str] = None, end_date: Optional[str] = None, model: Optional[str] = None, api_key: Optional[str] = None, page: int = 1, page_size: int = 10, exclude_end_user_ids: Optional[str] = None, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
